title: Filming: The Bruce McMouse Show by Wings | 1973
content:
Wings worked on The Bruce McMouse Show on 2 May 1973.

This was the first day of filming footage to be used in between live footage that had been captured during the Wings Over Europe Tour in August 1972. Paul McCartney had decided instead to release the footage as a film, titled The Bruce McMouse Show, and the live performances would be interspersed with animated footage of a family of mice living underneath the stage.

On this and the two subsequent days, Wings worked at Twickenham Film Studios, where they shot links between songs pretend conversations that would later include the animated mice.
